name: ASTM-A36--A36
notes:
Yield 250 MPa min, tensile 400-550 MPa. Most common general-purpose carbon structural steel.
[MakeItFrom.com] https://www.makeitfrom.com/material-properties/ASTM-A36-SS400-S275-Structural-Carbon-Steel

name: ASTM-A53--Gr-A
notes: Yield 207 MPa min, tensile 331 MPa min. Black/galvanized carbon steel pipe.

name: ASTM-A53--Gr-B
notes: Yield 241 MPa min, tensile 414 MPa min. Most common A53 pipe grade.

name: ASTM-A53--Type-E
notes: ERW pipe — manufacturing process variant of A53 Gr A or B.

name: ASTM-A53--Type-S
notes: Seamless pipe — manufacturing process variant of A53 Gr A or B.

name: ASTM-A53--Type-F
notes: Furnace butt-welded pipe; only Grade A. Limited to NPS 4 and smaller.

name: ASTM-A106--Gr-A
notes: Yield 207 MPa min, tensile 331 MPa min. Seamless carbon steel pipe for high-temperature service.

name: ASTM-A106--Gr-B
notes: Yield 241 MPa min, tensile 414 MPa min. Most common process piping grade.

name: ASTM-A106--Gr-C
notes: Yield 276 MPa min, tensile 483 MPa min. Higher-strength A106 variant.

name: ASTM-A283--Gr-A
notes: Yield 165 MPa, tensile 310-415 MPa. Low-tensile carbon steel plate.

name: ASTM-A283--Gr-C
notes: Yield 207 MPa, tensile 380-485 MPa. Most common A283 grade.

name: ASTM-A285--Gr-A
notes: Yield 165 MPa, tensile 310-415 MPa. PV plate, low tensile.

name: ASTM-A285--Gr-C
notes: Yield 207 MPa, tensile 380-515 MPa. Most common A285 grade.

name: ASTM-A335--P1
notes: 0.5Mo (no Cr). Discontinued by some users; superseded by P11/P22 in new design.

name: ASTM-A335--P9
notes: 9Cr-1Mo. Refining/heater tubes; superseded by P91 in many designs.

name: ASTM-A335--P11
notes: 1.25Cr-0.5Mo. Most common Cr-Mo pipe grade for 480-565°C service.

name: ASTM-A335--P24
notes: 2.25Cr-1Mo-V-Ti-B advanced low-alloy creep grade. Used in supercritical boilers.

name: ASTM-A335--P91
notes: 9Cr-1Mo-V-Nb (modified 9Cr-1Mo). Standard supercritical boiler grade. Strict heat-treatment & weld procedure controls.

name: ASTM-A335--P92
notes: 9Cr-1.8W-0.5Mo-V-Nb. Higher creep strength than P91 for ultra-supercritical service.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-2-Cl-1
notes: 0.5Cr-0.5Mo plate. Class 1: annealed. Lower yield/tensile than Cl 2.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-2-Cl-2
notes: 0.5Cr-0.5Mo plate. Class 2: normalized + tempered. Higher strength.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-11-Cl-1
notes: 1.25Cr-0.5Mo plate. PV equivalent of A335 P11 pipe. Class 1: annealed. Lower yield/tensile than Cl 2.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-11-Cl-2
notes: 1.25Cr-0.5Mo plate. PV equivalent of A335 P11 pipe. Class 2: normalized + tempered. Higher strength.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-12-Cl-1
notes: 1Cr-0.5Mo plate. PV equivalent of A335 P12 pipe. Class 1: annealed. Lower yield/tensile than Cl 2.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-12-Cl-2
notes: 1Cr-0.5Mo plate. PV equivalent of A335 P12 pipe. Class 2: normalized + tempered. Higher strength.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-21-Cl-1
notes: 3Cr-1Mo plate. Class 1: annealed. Lower yield/tensile than Cl 2.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-21-Cl-2
notes: 3Cr-1Mo plate. Class 2: normalized + tempered. Higher strength.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-22-Cl-1
notes: 2.25Cr-1Mo plate. PV equivalent of A335 P22 pipe. Class 1: annealed. Lower yield/tensile than Cl 2.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-22-Cl-2
notes: 2.25Cr-1Mo plate. PV equivalent of A335 P22 pipe. Class 2: normalized + tempered. Higher strength.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-23-Cl-1
notes: 2.25Cr-1.6W-V-Nb advanced creep plate. Class 1: annealed. Lower yield/tensile than Cl 2.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-23-Cl-2
notes: 2.25Cr-1.6W-V-Nb advanced creep plate. Class 2: normalized + tempered. Higher strength.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-91-Cl-1
notes: 9Cr-1Mo-V-Nb (modified). PV equivalent of A335 P91. Class 2 only typical. Class 1: annealed. Lower yield/tensile than Cl 2.

name: ASTM-A387--Gr-91-Cl-2
notes: 9Cr-1Mo-V-Nb (modified). PV equivalent of A335 P91. Class 2 only typical. Class 2: normalized + tempered. Higher strength.

name: ASTM-A516--Gr-55
notes: Yield 205 MPa min, tensile 380-515 MPa. Lowest A516 grade.

name: ASTM-A516--Gr-70
notes: Yield 260 MPa min, tensile 485-620 MPa. Most common pressure vessel plate.

name: ASTM-A572--Gr-42
notes: Yield 290 MPa, tensile 415 MPa min. HSLA Cb-V.

name: ASTM-A572--Gr-50
notes: Yield 345 MPa, tensile 450 MPa min. Most common HSLA structural grade — replaces A36 in many bridge/building applications.

name: ASTM-A588--Gr-A
notes: Yield 345 MPa, tensile 485 MPa min. Weathering steel (Cor-Ten A type).

name: ASTM-A588--Gr-B
notes: Yield 345 MPa, tensile 485 MPa min. Weathering steel.

name: ASTM-A588--Gr-C
notes: Yield 345 MPa, tensile 485 MPa min. Weathering steel.

name: ASTM-A588--Gr-K
notes: Yield 345 MPa, tensile 485 MPa min. Weathering steel — niobium variant.

name: ASTM-A992--A992
notes: Yield 345-450 MPa, tensile 450 MPa min. Default US wide-flange (W) shape grade. Replaces A36 / A572-50 for shapes since 1998.

name: ASTM-A240--304
notes: Standard 18-8 austenitic stainless. Yield 205 MPa, tensile 515 MPa min.

name: ASTM-A240--304L
notes: Low carbon variant of 304. Improves intergranular corrosion resistance after welding. Yield 170 MPa, tensile 485 MPa min.

name: ASME-SA-240--321
notes: Ti-stabilized austenitic, prevents sensitization in 425-815°C range. Yield 205 MPa min.

name: ASTM-A240--321
notes: Ti-stabilized austenitic, prevents sensitization in 425-815°C range. Yield 205 MPa min.

name: ASME-SA-240--321H
notes: Higher carbon 321 for elevated-temperature service per ASME.

name: ASTM-A240--321H
notes: Higher carbon 321 for elevated-temperature service per ASME.

name: ASME-SA-240--347
notes: Nb-stabilized austenitic — equivalent of 321 with Nb instead of Ti.

name: ASTM-A240--347
notes: Nb-stabilized austenitic — equivalent of 321 with Nb instead of Ti.

name: ASME-SA-240--347H
notes: Higher carbon 347 for elevated-temperature service per ASME.

name: ASTM-A240--347H
notes: Higher carbon 347 for elevated-temperature service per ASME.

name: ASTM-A240--316
notes: Mo-bearing austenitic, improved chloride pitting resistance. Yield 205 MPa, tensile 515 MPa min.

name: ASTM-A240--316L
notes: Low-carbon 316. Yield 170 MPa, tensile 485 MPa min. Most common stainless for piping/vessels in chemical service.

name: ASTM-A240--316Ti
notes: Ti-stabilized 316 — combines 316 corrosion resistance with sensitization resistance.

name: ASTM-A240--317L
notes: Higher Mo (3-4%) than 316 — better chloride pitting resistance.

name: ASTM-A240--309
notes: Heat-resistant austenitic 22Cr-12Ni for service to 980°C. Common as filler for joining dissimilar metals.

name: ASTM-A240--904L
notes: Super-austenitic 25Ni-20Cr-4.5Mo-Cu. P-No 45 (high-Ni). Yield 220 MPa, tensile 490 MPa min. Sulfuric acid / chloride service.

name: ASTM-A240--405
notes: Low-Cr ferritic 12Cr-Al. Yield 170 MPa, tensile 415 MPa min. Heat-resistant cladding.

name: ASTM-A240--430
notes: 17Cr ferritic stainless. Yield 205 MPa, tensile 450 MPa min. Decorative + appliance grade.

name: ASTM-A240--446
notes: 27Cr ferritic stainless. Heat-resistant to 1100°C in oxidizing atmospheres.

name: ASTM-A240--410
notes: 12Cr martensitic stainless. Yield 205 MPa, tensile 450 MPa min in annealed. Strengthened by Q&T.

name: ASTM-A240--410S
notes: Low-C 410 — does not harden on cooling, weldable without preheat.

name: ASTM-A240--420
notes: 13Cr martensitic — higher C than 410 for hardness/cutlery.

name: ASTM-A240--2205
notes: 22Cr-5Ni-3Mo-N duplex. Yield 450 MPa, tensile 620 MPa min. Standard duplex for chloride service.

name: ASTM-A240--S32205
notes: Variant of 2205 with tighter chemistry — same group.

name: ASTM-A240--2507
notes: Super-duplex 25Cr-7Ni-4Mo-N. Yield 550 MPa, tensile 795 MPa min. Highest chloride/sour resistance among duplex grades.

name: API-5L--B
notes: Equivalent of A53 Gr B / A106 Gr B. Yield 241 MPa, tensile 414 MPa min.

name: API-5L--X52
notes: Yield 359 MPa, tensile 455 MPa min. Most common pipeline grade.

name: API-5L--X70
notes: Yield 483 MPa, tensile 565 MPa min. Common high-pressure long-distance pipeline grade.

name: API-5L--X80
notes: Yield 552 MPa, tensile 621 MPa min. Modern long-distance pipeline grade (TMCP).

name: EN-10025-2--S235JR
notes: Yield 235 MPa min, tensile 360-510 MPa. Most basic European structural steel — no impact requirement.

name: EN-10025-2--S355JR
notes: Yield 355 MPa min, tensile 470-630 MPa. Most common European mid-strength structural grade.

name: EN-10025-2--S355K2
notes: S355 with Charpy 40J at -20°C (higher impact than J2).

name: EN-10025-6--S690Q
notes: Q&T 690 MPa min yield. Common heavy machinery & crane plate.

name: EN-10025-6--S960Q
notes: Q&T 960 MPa min yield. Highest-strength structural plate; strict weld procedure controls.

name: EN-10028-2--P235GH
notes: Yield 235 MPa min. Pressure vessel C-Mn plate for elevated temperature.

name: EN-10028-2--P265GH
notes: Yield 265 MPa min. Most common European PV plate.

name: EN-10028-2--P355GH
notes: Yield 355 MPa min. European equivalent of A516 Gr 70.

name: EN-10216-2--P195GH
notes: Carbon steel seamless pressure tube, low strength.

name: EN-10216-2--P235GH
notes: Carbon steel seamless pressure tube, 235 MPa yield.

name: EN-10216-2--P265GH
notes: Carbon steel seamless pressure tube, 265 MPa yield. Common power-piping grade.

name: EN-10216-2--16Mo3
notes: 0.5Mo creep alloy seamless tube. Equivalent of ASTM A335 P1 / A209 T1.

name: EN-10216-2--13CrMo4-5
notes: 1Cr-0.5Mo creep alloy seamless tube. Equivalent of ASTM A335 P12.

name: EN-10216-2--10CrMo9-10
notes: 2.25Cr-1Mo creep alloy seamless tube. Equivalent of ASTM A335 P22.

name: EN-10216-2--X10CrMoVNb9-1
notes: 9Cr-1Mo-V-Nb (P91 equivalent) seamless tube for supercritical service.
